description:
Partial progress after #1581 (expose-update-verb-in-project-wrapper).

Already done in BenchBox mirrors (PR #1581):
- .claude/skills/todo-db/skill.yaml has standalone_only_commands: {}
- SKILL.md no longer claims update is standalone-only
- tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_wrapper.py expects update as a real handler
- medium-lane wrapper tests are green with that surface

Still open (this item):
- Canonical skill-sync source (/Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills/todo-db or skill-sync-skills git) still listed update as standalone before the pin
- Bump skill-sync.yaml pin + skill-sync.lock, make skill-sync, confirm multi-agent mirrors (.codex/.gemini/.antigravity) stay consistent
- queries.md / skill references: no residual "standalone-only update" gating language at the source of truth

Without the pin bump, the next make skill-sync may reintroduce the old declaration and re-break medium tests.

preserves.behavior: The contract test keeps its teeth: no allowlisting, no test deletion

verifications.expected: all pass with update as a real wrapper handler

work_units.summary: Drop update from standalone_only_commands + queries.md gating at canonical source, land on main, bump BenchBox pin, resync mirrors
